Line 8. Paolo, responsible for the structures department, reports case P04-007, status approved, budget 2276 euros, deadline 2026-11-12. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 9. Rita, responsible for the construction department, reports case P04-008, status approved, budget 5429 euros, deadline 2026-11-13. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
